newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end down on uncertainty.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end down on uncertainty.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished lower on Sunday on uncertainty about whether the new government's reform programme could be implemented successfully, dealers said.
New finance chief Shahid Javed Burki set out a sweeping reform programme on Saturday to put the country's economic house in order and regain the favour of the IMF and World Bank.
The Karachi 100-share index fell 24.68 points, or 1.63 percent, to 1,492.19. Losers led gainers 165 to 51. Pakistan State Oil fell 11 rupees to 383 and Engro Chemicals 5.0 to 141.
